name: Swift Hampi
title: Swift Hampi tour — 2 days & 1 night
imageAlt: The Stone Chariot in the courtyard of Vittala Temple, Hampi
tagline: A short escape. A whole new perspective.
intro: Sometimes, a change of scene is all you need. Give yourself a little time away from the everyday, and let the journey do the rest.
expect: Have a weekend in mind? Start here. Swift is for travellers who want a compact break, with the stay and sightseeing brought into one plan. Arrive with a pair of comfortable shoes, a little curiosity, and an idea of what you would most like to see. We’ll talk through your arrival and departure times before you book, so you know how your days will fit together.
pickup: Hospet railway station or bus stand
dropoff: Hospet railway station or bus stand
transferCopy: Share both your arrival and return timings when you enquire. We’ll agree on a meeting point and plan the sightseeing around the time you have. Keep your departure details handy, especially if your second day is shorter.
stayCopy: A good short break begins with a stay that suits you. Tell us whether you prefer a simple room, more comfort, or something special. The property and room type will be named in your quote before you confirm.
faqs: Is two days enough?
It’s a compact introduction, so tell us which stops matter most to you. If you would rather spend longer at each place, ask about adding a day or choosing Heritage.
Can I arrive late on the first day?
Share your arrival time before booking. We’ll explain what can fit into the remaining day and agree on any changes with you.
Are the second-day stops guaranteed?
They depend on your departure time. We’ll work through the available sightseeing window with you before the itinerary is confirmed.

name: Heritage Hampi
title: Heritage Hampi tour — 3 days & 2 nights
imageAlt: A stone pavilion on Hemakuta Hill overlooking Virupaksha Temple
intro: Stay for the details. Leave room for a second look, a longer conversation, and the moments that never quite fit into a photograph.
expect: An extra day can change the way a trip feels. There’s time to settle in, follow your interests, and take a little more notice of what’s around you. Heritage is a useful starting point if you would like a longer break without making the holiday an extended road trip. Tell us about your group and the pace you enjoy; we’ll discuss the plan before you set off.
pickup: Hospet railway station or bus stand
dropoff: Hospet railway station or bus stand
transferCopy: Send us your arrival details and your return departure time. We’ll agree on the pickup point, the final sightseeing window, and the time you need to be back. If you have a particular stop in mind, mention it while we’re shaping your plan.
stayCopy: You’ll return to the same base for two nights, so choose the kind of stay you enjoy coming back to. Tell us your room preferences and budget; the hotel name, room type and included meals will be confirmed in your quote.
faqs: How is Heritage different from Swift?
Choose Heritage if you would like another day to explore. If you’re deciding between them, share your arrival and departure timings and we’ll help you compare the plans.
Is the hill visit suitable for everyone?
Tell us about any mobility needs or if you would prefer to avoid climbs. We’ll discuss the walking involved and agree on alternatives where needed.
Can we change the final day?
Tell us your interests and your departure time. We’ll discuss a revised plan and confirm any change to the quote before booking.

name: Regal explorations
title: Regal heritage tour — 4 days & 3 nights
imageAlt: Agastya Lake surrounded by sandstone cliffs and temples in Badami
tagline: Four places. More reasons to take the road.
intro: Let the landscape change outside your window. Follow your interest a little further, and make the journey itself part of the holiday.
expect: If you enjoy holidays that keep unfolding, this is a good place to begin. Regal brings several destinations into one journey, with travel between them as well as time on foot. Before you book, we’ll talk through the driving, the walking, your stay preferences, and your departure plans. It helps to arrive with a little flexibility: leave space for a rest when you need one, and tell us which places you’re most looking forward to.
pickup: Hospet railway station or bus stand
dropoff: Hospet or Badami station / bus stand, agreed with your quote
stays: 1 night in Hampi · 2 nights in Badami
transferCopy: Tell us where you want to finish the trip before making your return booking. We’ll confirm the drop-off point, transfer coverage and departure time in your quote. It’s worth checking these together so the last day feels as well planned as the first.
stayCopy: With more than one overnight base, room preferences matter throughout the trip. Tell us what makes a stay comfortable for you. We’ll name the properties at each base and confirm their room types and meal plans before you book.
faqs: How much time will we spend driving?
Ask us for the driving plan with your quote. The route moves between destinations, so we’ll discuss travel time alongside the sightseeing and breaks.
Where should I book my return journey from?
Confirm your final drop-off with us first. Your quote will state the departure point and what transfer is covered.
Can we extend the trip?
Yes, ask us about the time you would like to add. We’ll discuss the revised route, accommodation and price before you decide.

name: Hampi by car
title: Hampi sightseeing by car — a private day tour
imageAlt: The carved stone wheels and pillars of the Stone Chariot in Hampi
tagline: One day. Your own way around.
intro: Already unpacked? Make a day of it. Step out, follow your curiosity, and return with a little more to remember than you expected.
expect: Some holidays need a full plan; others just need a well spent day. This tour is for travellers who have arranged their stay and want help getting around. Tell us where you’re staying, when you’d like to begin, and the places you’re especially keen to visit. We’ll discuss the route and car with you, so you can start the day with the practical details settled.
pickup: Your hotel or agreed address in Hampi / Hospet
dropoff: Your hotel or agreed address in Hampi / Hospet
transferCopy: Send us your accommodation name and address when you enquire. We’ll agree on a pickup time and return point. If you’re fitting the tour around a train or bus, mention that early so we can discuss a suitable sightseeing window.
stayCopy: Keep the accommodation you’ve already chosen. This is a sightseeing service rather than a stay package. If you would like us to arrange a hotel as well, ask about Swift or Heritage instead.
faqs: Is the price per person?
No. The starting price is per private car for up to four guests. Tell us your group size and vehicle preference for a confirmed quote.
Do we have to see every stop?
Tell us what interests you most and how much time you have. We’ll discuss a route that suits your day before confirming it.
Can we book a larger vehicle?
Tell us the number of adults and children, and any luggage you’ll carry. We’ll discuss suitable options and confirm the vehicle-specific rate with you.
